title: Warehouse Keeper

warehouse/30182.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Cliff: Welcome, welcome! Isn't that equipment heavy? Put it down and give your back a rest, friend! In fact, why not leave what you don't need here with us? You won't find a safer, more secure place to store your valuables than a Dwarven warehouse. Empires may rise and fall, but ou…

warehouse/30182-noteach.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Cliff: Who are you? Just look at yourself. Where's your beard, then? You're no Dwarf!

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30182-01.html.text: Warehouse Freightman Cliff: Ah, so you were sent by Maestro Reorin? What wonderful news! How is the Maestro? I am so glad to hear he is active again. I feel bad because I've been too busy to go and see him. What happened was so sad... To tell you the truth, I couldn't bear to look him in the eye.

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30182-05.html.text: Warehouse Freightman Cliff: Why haven't you left? Take the Infernium Varnish to the Maestro immediately! We mustn't delay his work!

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30182-06.html.text: Warehouse Freightman Cliff: Good news! The guild elders have issued Maestro Reorin a pardon! Hopefully now he can put all the unpleasantness behind him and get back to work at the blacksmith guild. What a shame that I am now a warehouse keeper and will not get the pleasure of working with him... Oh…

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30833-01.html.text: Magister Kaspar: Ah, you must have come for Maestro Reorin's Mold. How is Reorin? I should check you out. Uh oh, did I say that out loud? Sorry... I was just talking to myself. If you knew what I went throught to get this mold, you would understand why I can't just give it to you for nothing... If …

links.text: "What do you want me to do?"

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30833-03.html.text: Magister Kaspar: Have you met Magister Hanellin of the Town of Aden ? Baium will tell you how to access the sealed room on the top floor of the Tower of Insolence. Please don't forget that you promised to cut Baium with the pipet knife I gave you, and absorb at least a few drops of his blood. This …

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30833-04.html.text: Magister Kaspar: You exceeded my expectations! Excellent job! Obviously, there is more to you than meets the eye. I now see that the attention you've been getting is well-deserved. Well, as promised, here is Maestro Reorin's Mold . As it is said, a person's belongings have a way of finding their wa…

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30833-03c.html.text: Magister Kaspar: Did you acquire the Blood of the Angel? Staining the white cloth I gave to you with it will be easier than going to Baium, don't you think? But is this all you've done? Time to prove your worth, my young friend.

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30833-03d.html.text: Magister Kaspar: You're as good as advertised. Well done! To be honest, I had my doubts you would succeed. But you exceeded my expectations. Now I now why so many speak so highly of you. Now, as promised, I'll return Maestro Reorin's mold to you. It's only right that an item like this should go bac…

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30833-03e.html.text: Magister Kaspar: Did you forget your promise? I don't know why your reputation is as high as it is. But I suppose everyone can fall flat now and again. I'll give you another chance: take these 30 pieces of white cloth and dye all of them with the Blood of the Angel.

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30833-05.html.text: Magister Kaspar: Maestro Reorin's "Dasparion's Staff" is world-renowned, even among the Magi. It is rumored that he is working on a new weapon! I can't wait to see what he comes up with!

Q00384_WarehouseKeepersPastime/30182-01..text: Warehouse Freightman Cliff: Being a warehouse keeper can be very boring, just sitting around waiting for people to bring items in. Warehouse keepers think of different ways to amuse themselves. I usually pass the time playing bingo with other warehouse keepers. On my day off, I visit the warehouse …
Q00384_WarehouseKeepersPastime/30182-01..dpText: Warehouse Keeper Cliff: Don't tell my boss, but this job can get kinda slow. That's why we warehouse keepers created our own fun. I often play bingo with the other warehouse keepers. Sometime I even go over to another town's warehouse to play bingo on my days off. But to be honest, regular bingo ha…

Q00384_WarehouseKeepersPastime/30182-07..text: Warehouse Keeper Cliff: Did you recover my medals? Then let's play bingo! According to rules of the game, you can bet either 10 or 100 medals. Of course, betting 100 gives you a better chance of winning. Before we start, make sure you have enough space in your inventory -- if you win, you want to b…

Bet 100 Medals of the Warehouse Keeper.

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30182-02.html.text: Warehouse Freightman Cliff: Why do you seek Infernium Varnish? Don't tell me that Maestro Reorin is fooling around with demons again! He should know better than that, after what happened with the demon Hallate... He was tricked into making scepters for them! Oh, that's not it this time, eh?

links.text: "All the scepters have been recovered from the demons."

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30182-03.html.text: Warehouse Freightman Cliff: Very impressive! All the scepters! How wonderful! I must report this to the superiors at the guild! Perhaps they will reconsider his banishment for "dealings with demons". What does he intend to do with the scepters?

links.text: "He will melt them down in order to create something else."

Q00234_FatesWhisper/30182-04.html.text: Warehouse Freightman Cliff: Splendid! What is he going to make? I can't wait to see it! Here you go, take this Infernium Varnish to the maestro immediately! I knew this stuff would come in handy someday... Now I am off to see the guild elders and tell them of the recovery of the scepters. Perhaps h…

Q00384_WarehouseKeepersPastime/30182-02..text: Warehouse Keeper Cliff: We've made the bingo games a little more interesting by adding some gambling. One of the perks of being a warehouse keeper is that there are all sorts of items left by owners who never come back to pick them up. That gives us a good stake for our games. Actually, though, I m…

Q00384_WarehouseKeepersPastime/30182-03..text: Warehouse Keeper Cliff: Recently, a cargo wagon from Hunter's Village was attacked by monsters , and all its freight was stolen. Most of the items weren't very valuable, but a large quantity of Medals of the Warehouse Keeper was also being transported. Every one was taken! Why were all those medals…

Q00384_WarehouseKeepersPastime/30182-05..text: Warehouse Keeper Cliff: Good! Bring back my Medals of the Warehouse Keeper and I'll give you a chance to play bingo with the big boys. If you do well, you can get an abandoned item from my warehouse as a reward. Who knows? You might get a nice weapon or a new set of armor. Ha ha! According to rules…

Q00384_WarehouseKeepersPastime/30182-08..text: Warehouse Keeper Cliff: Well, not all the medals have been recovered, but I understand. I'm sure you have other obligations... Come back whenever you want to play bingo again.

Q00384_WarehouseKeepersPastime/30182-09..text: Warehouse Keeper Cliff: I'll place numbers 1-9 on a 3x3 numberpad. Then you pick 6 numbers out of 1-9. Choose your first number.
